ai_language_tip: Use polite European Portuguese (pt-PT) vocabulary ('telemóvel', 'marcação', 'pequeno-almoço'); avoid blunt 'você'—use 'o senhor / a senhora'; English widely understood in Lisbon/Porto/Algarve.
english_ok: often — High English proficiency across Lisbon, Porto, Cascais, Madeira, and the Algarve; less common in rural interior towns.
politeness: Polite, respectful European Portuguese; open with 'Bom dia / Boa tarde' and 3rd-person indirect ('queria fazer uma marcação para o Sr./a Sra....'); close with 'muito obrigado(a), resto de bom dia'.
name_tip: First and last name (e.g. Tiago Ferreira, Inês Rodrigues); clinics and public services use full multi-part Portuguese name.
phone_tip: 9-digit numbers with NO area prefix: mobile 912 345 678 (91/92/93/96), Lisbon landline 21 123 4567; read 3-3-3; SMS/WhatsApp confirms.
time_tip: 24-hour common ('20h30'), spoken 'oito e meia da noite', 'um quarto para as oito' = 19:45; dinner typically 20:00–22:00.
number_tip: In Portugal digit 6 is ALWAYS 'seis' (NEVER 'meia' like Brazil!); 16/17/19 use European pronunciation ('dezasseis', 'dezassete', 'dezanove').
avoid_calling: Avoid restaurant rush 12:30–14:30 and 20:00–21:30, small-office lunch break 13:00–14:30, and calls after 21:00.
closed_days: Traditional restaurants close Sunday night or Monday; municipal holidays (Santos Populares: June 13 Lisbon / June 24 Porto) and August vacations.
booking_channels: TheFork and UMAI/Zenchef for restaurants; My CUF / MY LUZ / Lusíadas apps and Doctoralia for private health; Booksy and Treatwell for salons.
voice_menu: Private hospital groups (CUF, Luz Saúde, Lusíadas), SNS 24, banks, MEO/NOS/Vodafone, EDP, CTT, and TAP use keypad IVR.
callback_habits: SMS confirmations are standard across restaurants, private clinics, and salons; tradespeople often follow up by phone or WhatsApp.

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 葡萄牙餐廳習慣電話訂位（晚餐多在 20:00 後），里斯本與波多熱門店常用 TheFork 或 UMAI 綁卡。
usually_asked: Date and meal hour (almoço ~13:00 vs jantar ~20:30)
Number of people and cadeira de bebé
Special pre-order dish if traditional (e.g. leitão, arroz de marisco, cabrito)

may_come_up.what: Traditional tasca accepts Multibanco (Portuguese debit network) or cash only, no foreign Visa/Mastercard!
Sends UMAI/TheFork SMS link for card guarantee
Couvert (bread/olives starters brought to table) is optional and charged if eaten

sensitive_asked.what: Demands immediate MB WAY push payment to reserve table

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 大型私立醫院（CUF、Luz、Lusíadas）總機有按鍵選單；獨立牙醫與私人診所可直接電話預約。
usually_asked: Private self-pay vs insurance/subsystem (Médis, Multicare, AdvanceCare, ADSE)
Specialty or medicina dentária and first-visit status

may_come_up.what: Hospital group IVR requires pressing keypad options or using My CUF / MY LUZ app

sensitive_asked.what: Asks NIF (contribuinte), Número de Utente SNS, birth date, or insurance card number

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 理髮廳（Cabeleireiro / Barbearia）與美甲美容電話預約極普遍，年輕店家亦常用 Booksy 或 Treatwell。
usually_asked: Service (corte, brushing, madeixas/coloração, verniz gel, massagem)
Hair length or verniz gel removal

may_come_up.what: Directs caller to Booksy app for barber slot

sensitive_asked.what: Demands immediate MB WAY deposit (sinal por MB WAY)

repair.before_dialing_zh: 修車廠（Oficina）與家電維修電話直接；汽車定期驗車（IPO — Inspeção Automóvel）可電話或上網預約。
usually_asked: Vehicle matrícula (plate, e.g. AA-00-AA) and make/model, or device model

may_come_up.what: Quotes diagnostic/orçamento fee if not repaired

sensitive_asked.what: Asks phone PIN code or NIF
Demands MB WAY advance for parts

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 葡式烤雞店（Churrasqueira）、傳統餐廳與披薩店很習慣電話訂外帶自取（Take-away）到店付。
usually_asked: Take-away / levantar na loja vs entrega
Dishes (meia dose vs dose inteira!), piri-piri sauce, and sides

may_come_up.what: Portuguese 'uma dose' often feeds 2 people ('meia dose' = 1 generous portion!); packaging fee extra
Delivery handled via Uber Eats / Glovo / Bolt Food

sensitive_asked.what: Requests MB WAY payment before cooking
Asks NIF for fatura over phone

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 獨立書店、糕點店（Pastelaria）、肉鋪與海鮮店歡迎電話留貨；大賣場走客服語音選單。
usually_asked: Product name, weight, size, or reference

may_come_up.what: Holds unpaid item until end of day

sensitive_asked.what: Requires MB WAY sinal for custom cake/seafood order

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期當地稱「adiar / alterar a marcação」，綁卡餐廳或私人診所 24 小時內取消可能收費。

may_come_up.what: No-show fee on UMAI/TheFork guaranteed table inside 24h

sensitive_asked.what: Clinic asks NIF or Número de Utente to open file

usually_asked: Question (hours, Multibanco vs foreign Visa acceptance, esplanada dog rule, stock, parking)

may_come_up.what: Accepts Multibanco/cash only (no foreign cards)

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 鄉村莊園（Turismo Rural / Quinta）與精品旅宿電話友善；連鎖飯店有按鍵總機且需信用卡擔保。
usually_asked: Adults, children, and cama de casal vs twin

may_come_up.what: Taxa municipal turística (city tax) extra; sends email link for card guarantee

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card digits or passport/CC number over phone
Demands immediate MB WAY payment now

activity.before_dialing_zh: 板網球（Padel 在葡萄牙極盛行，常用 Tie Player / Playtomic）、衝浪課（Aula de surf）、酒莊品酒與高爾夫可電話洽詢。
usually_asked: Court, surf lesson, wine tasting, or boat tour

may_come_up.what: Surf lesson start time shifts with ocean tide; instructor confirms day before
Padel club books courts via Tie Player or Playtomic app

sensitive_asked.what: Demands immediate MB WAY payment to confirm

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 必須給完整地址與 7 碼郵遞區號（xxxx-xxx，含樓層左/右如 3.º Esq./Dto.）。
usually_asked: Service (canalizador, eletricista, esquentador/ar condicionado, abertura de portas, limpezas)
Street, number, floor + side (Esq./Dto./Frente), and 7-digit código postal

may_come_up.what: Quotes taxa de deslocação (call-out fee) + 23% IVA

sensitive_asked.what: Asks building código da porta or NIF over phone
Demands MB WAY transfer before arriving

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫（Veterinário）、美容（Tosquia e banho）與寵物旅館（Hotel canino/felino）皆需預約。
usually_asked: Consulta veterinária, banho e tosa/tosquia, or hotel canino
Rabies and kennel-cough (tosse do canil) vaccines + microchip

may_come_up.what: Holiday boarding requires advance booking weeks ahead

sensitive_asked.what: Requires MB WAY/transfer sinal for boarding

tracking.before_dialing_zh: CTT Expresso、DPD、GLS 全國專線多有按鍵語音選單；獨立門市、修車廠與洗衣店（Lavandaria）才適合直撥。
usually_asked: Tracking object number or repair talão/folha de obra

may_come_up.what: CTT hotline uses automated voice/keypad IVR

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CTT Cacifo locker PIN or delivery PIN

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信（MEO/NOS/Vodafone）、EDP電力、銀行與葡航（TAP）皆有按鍵選單並嚴格要求本人核驗 NIF 與生日，AI 無法代辦。
usually_asked: NIF, Cartão de Cidadão / birth date, and client number

may_come_up.what: RGPD blocks assistant from account details

sensitive_asked.what: Asks NIF, Cartão de Cidadão, birth date, card digits, or MB WAY/SMS code

transport.before_dialing_zh: 除了 Uber 與 Bolt 外，無線計程車合作社（Rádio Táxis / Cooptáxis）、接機專車與地方租車行皆可電話叫車。
usually_asked: Exact street, door number, postal code, and pickup time
Passengers, suitcases (bagagem supplement on meter), or 7-seat táxi

may_come_up.what: Call-dispatch fee (chamada telefónica 0.80€) and luggage supplement apply on taxi meter

sensitive_asked.what: Car rental asks carta de condução or card number over phone

property.before_dialing_zh: Idealista 房仲接電話積極，里斯本與波多租房常問有無葡萄牙保人（Fiador）與報稅單（IRS）。
usually_asked: Idealista/Imovirtual ID or parish (freguesia) and typology (T1/T2/T3)
Occupants, pets, employment/IRS income proof, and fiador availability

may_come_up.what: Landlord requires Portuguese fiador or extra months of caução if foreign income

sensitive_asked.what: Asks NIF or passport number over phone
Requests reservation fee before viewing

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 市民服務中心（Loja de Cidadão）、AIMA 與稅務局多需線上取號且有語音選單；私立托嬰幼兒園（Creche / Colégio）可電話約參觀。
usually_asked: General procedure question or creche/colégio visit
Child birth month and Creche Feliz free-program availability

may_come_up.what: Creche Feliz subsidized spots have long waitlists; private fee spots may differ
Public line uses keypad IVR

sensitive_asked.what: Asks NIF, Número de Segurança Social (NISS), or birth date
